chunks: And by this chain, from Yunus, from Wahb ibn Abd Rabbih, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The one who neglects the Qunut, turning away from it, so there is no Salat for him.

key_terms.رَغْبَةً عَنْهُ: Turning away from it / out of disdain

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on neglecting the Qunut in prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the spiritual gravity of Qunut, distinguishing between mere omission and active disdain (raghbatan 'anhu), which renders the prayer deficient. In Shia jurisprudence, this underscores that Qunut is not merely a recommended act but a significant component of devotion, particularly in the Fajr prayer, where its neglect due to arrogance compromises the prayer's integrity. The hadith serves as a reminder that the internal attitude of the worshipper is as critical as the external performance of the ritual.
